## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, format, types, tests with coverage)
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests, and a bug fix has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] `docs/openapi.yaml` updated if a route changed
- [ ] README or an ADR updated if behavior or a design decision changed
- [ ] No secrets, real keys or personal data in the diff
